prose.subject: Quick Reminder: Invoice INV-39039
prose.body:
Hi Driftmoor Retail team,

Hope you’re having a great week! This is just a friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-39039 for 5146.06 USDC.

We’ve processed the details on our end, and everything looks good. To keep things moving smoothly, please ensure the payment is sent to our standard vendor wallet address below. As always, this is the same address we’ve used for previous transactions, so no changes there.

Payment Address: 0xadfecc5e8f1a0feb73a79fe222c55157009d0b78

If you have any questions or need an updated copy of the invoice, just let me know. We appreciate your prompt attention to this.

Best regards,

Accounts Receivable
Juniper Logistics
